from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class GoodwillBalance(BaseModel):
    """A single reported goodwill value from a 10-K filing."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="The company name as reported in the document")
    filing_fiscal_year: str = Field(description="The fiscal year of the 10-K report itself (e.g., '2021')")
    balance_sheet_year_end: str = Field(description="The specific year-end the goodwill amount corresponds to (e.g., '2021', '2020')")
    amount: float = Field(description="The reported Goodwill amount as a numeric value")
    unit: str = Field(description="The unit of the amount (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    goodwill_balances: list[GoodwillBalance]
